# sce_forge_runtime — header-only algorithm and HAL library for code
# generated by SCE Forge (filter, interpolation, timer, observer kinds).
#
# Policy: see SCE_FORGE.md §2.1
#   - Static linking only, no dynamic dependencies
#   - No stateful global services (no heap, no threads, no I/O in the library)
#   - Header-only templates and pure-virtual interfaces only

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

add_library(sce_forge_runtime INTERFACE)
add_library(sce::forge_runtime ALIAS sce_forge_runtime)

target_include_directories(sce_forge_runtime INTERFACE
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

target_compile_features(sce_forge_runtime INTERFACE cxx_std_17)
